descriptions.preferred: The outstanding feature of this cultivar is the persistence of the good, deep red color of the foliage. Most dissectum cultivars with excellent red color during spring andearlysummerturngreenorbronze.'CrimsonQueen', however, carries the deep red color throughout the entire growing season. It has endured periods of 38°C temperatures in full sun with practically no sunburn, but under these conditions the deep red became orange red. Fall colors range into the extremely bright scarlet tones. The finely dissected leaves have lobes up to 9 cm long, with the side lobes 5-6 cm long. Each narrow lobe is deeply divided and notched. The scarlet petioles range up to 4 cm long. This strong-growing cultivar originated in the United States and ages into a beautiful cascading form. Under very vigorous conditions, young plants put out shoots upto60-65cmlong.Astheplantsage,thegrowthshoots become shorter and form a more dense growth. The tree reaches 3 m high and 4 m wide. sources.title: 绯红皇后 Acer Palmatum 'Crimson Queen'
sources.description: 这一款非常流行的品种，叶色非常具有特点，可以长时 间保持深红色的叶片。多数红叶羽毛枫只在春季叶色鲜 亮，初夏即变为绿色或古铜色。绯红皇后却与此不同， 它在整个生长季都能保持深红色。秋季叶片则为明亮的 绯红色。叶片中等至大型，具 7-9 裂，羽叶细腻。其 叶裂深，裂叶狭窄，叶缘有锯齿。叶柄较短，呈绯红色。 绯红皇后源自美国，它长势旺盛，成熟株高可达 3m， 冠幅可达 4m，树形如瀑布。它曾经获得过英国皇家园 艺协会的花园优秀植物奖（the RHS Award of Garden Merit）。

sources.name: Crimson Queen Laceleaf Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Crimson Queen Japanese Maple is a stunning laceleaf variety that stands out for its vivid red foliage and elegant, cascading growth habit. Known for its compact size and refined appearance, this tree is a favorite among gardeners and landscape designers looking to create a striking focal point. With its finely dissected leaves and weeping form, the Crimson Queen adds texture and color to any garden, patio, or outdoor space. This variety is particularly prized for its vibrant scarlet foliage that holds its color throughout the growing season, transitioning to a fiery crimson-red in autumn. Typically reaching a height of 2 to 3 meters, the Crimson Queen is ideal for smaller gardens, container planting, or accenting larger landscapes. It thrives in well-drained soil with partial shade and requires minimal care, making it an excellent choice for both novice and experienced gardeners. At Herter Nursery, we cultivate each Crimson Queen Japanese Maple with meticulous care to ensure healthy growth and vibrant foliage. Whether you’re creating a serene Japanese-inspired garden or simply looking for a beautiful tree to elevate your outdoor space, the Crimson Queen delivers unmatched beauty. Explore our collection today and bring home this iconic tree to transform your landscape.

rhs.description: A medium-sized deciduous shrub, arching in habit, with deep reddish-purple leaves divided into 7-9 narrow, deeply incised lobes. The foliage turns to shades of red and orange in the autumn. Small, purple flowers appear in spring, followed by purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种最突出的特点，是其叶片优良而深浓的红色具有很强的持久性。多数细裂叶品种虽在春季和初夏呈现极佳红色，但随后会转绿或转铜色；而 'Crimson Queen' 在整个生长季都能保持深红叶色。它曾在 38°C 的全日照条件下经受高温而几乎不发生日灼，不过在这种环境下，深红色会转为橘红色。秋色可发展为极其鲜亮的猩红色调。叶片细裂，裂片最长可达 9 厘米，侧裂片长 5-6 厘米。每个狭长裂片又深裂并具缺刻。鲜红色叶柄最长可达 4 厘米。该强健生长的品种起源于美国，成熟后形成优美的下垂开展株形。在生长势极旺的条件下，幼株可抽生长达 60-65 厘米的新梢。随着植株老熟，新梢长度会缩短，株型也会变得更为紧密。树高可达 3 米，冠幅约 4 米。在众多已知的红叶细裂品种中，它已成为备受喜爱的一个品种。

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小的落叶灌木，枝条开展下拱。叶片深红紫色，分成 7-9 个狭长且深裂的裂片。秋季叶色转为红色和橙色调。春季开小型紫色花，随后结紫色果实

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于河岸与斜坡、城市/庭院花园、乡村风/自然式花园、低维护种植。
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Crimson Queen' Laceleaf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Crimson Queen' Red Weeping Laceleaf Crimson Queen Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Crimson Queen’ is a small red weeping Japanese maple. As the spring colors unfold, this is one of the best trees for deep crimson-purple reds. During the summer months, ‘Crimson Queen’ holds its color well. The fall color of this Japanese maple is a bright crimson red. 'Crimson Queen' performs the best in filtered light and is not recommended for direct late day sun. This is an excellent small red weeping Japanese maple cultivar that reaches around 3-4 ft in 15 years. The small size of Acer palmatum ‘Crimson Queen’ make it an excellent choice for container growing.
